description:
This is a non-motorized trail.
Altitude: 2170m, Elevation Gain 715m, Hiking Time: +/- 5 hrs, Hiking Distance: 9.5 km. Vista Pass lies on the divide between the Okanagan and Arrow Lakes with spectacular views of the Pinnacle Peaks.

This trail should be considered "user-maintained" and visitors should be completely self-reliant. There are no facilities beyond the parking lot.
directions:
The South Fork Forest Service Road is a radio-controlled road. It is a busy industrial road. All road users are advised to exercise extreme caution and follow posted resource road protocol.
Learn more about: Okanagan Shuswap Natural Resource District Road safety information Travel time: +/- 2hrs. From Vernon take Hwy 6 past Lumby for 66 km. Turn left 1.5 km past Goldpanner Cafe onto South Fork Forest Service Road. Drive past the Pinnacles Hiking Area sign post and follow the Vista Pass sign posts to 23 km until you reach the trailhead. The road is passable for vehicles with good clearance.
New Access Location approx. at 50.178407 -118.536380 off Hwy 6.
title: Vista Pass (Pinnacles)
